# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure yet whether venmo payments use the same 'Friends Dinner' description; will inspect transactions in a relevant time window.</uncertainty>

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=simple_note_token)
content = note.get('content','')
print('note_id', note['note_id'], 'title', note.get('title'))
print('created_at', note.get('created_at'))
print('updated_at', note.get('updated_at'))
print('content:', content)

# Parse lines like: - Name => $36
shares = {}
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('- '):
        continue
    m = None
    # Accept variations of spacing
    # Example: - Adrian => $36
    import re
    m = re.match(r'^-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*$', line)
    if m:
        name = m.group(1).strip()
        amt = float(m.group(2))
        shares[name]=amt
    else:
        # try without $ symbol
        m = re.match(r'^-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*$', line)
        if m:
            name=m.group(1).strip(); amt=float(m.group(2)); shares[name]=amt

print('parsed shares:', shares)
print('participants count:', len(shares))

# Determine date window around the note date
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
note_date = datetime.fromisoformat(note['created_at']).date()
min_date = (note_date - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
max_date = (note_date + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
print('note_date', note_date, 'min_date', min_date, 'max_date', max_date)

# Fetch received transactions in that window
received_txns=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at=min_date,
        max_created_at=max_date,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit,
        sort_by='-created_at'
    )
    print('received page', page_index, 'len', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    received_txns.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

print('total received_txns in window:', len(received_txns))

# Print those whose amount matches one of our shares (or close)
amounts_set=set(shares.values())
matched=[]
for t in received_txns:
    amt=float(t.get('amount',0.0))
    if any(abs(amt-a)<1e-6 for a in amounts_set):
        matched.append(t)

print('matched by exact amount to our shares:', len(matched))
for t in matched:
    sender=t.get('sender',{})
    print('txn_id', t.get('transaction_id'), 'amount', t.get('amount'), 'sender', sender.get('name'), sender.get('email'), 'created_at', t.get('created_at'), 'desc', t.get('description'))

# Also look for description containing 'Friends Dinner'
fd_desc=[]
for t in received_txns:
    desc=(t.get('description') or '').lower()
    if 'friends' in desc and 'dinner' in desc:
        fd_desc.append(t)
print('transactions with description containing friends+dinner:', len(fd_desc))
for t in fd_desc:
    sender=t.get('sender',{})
    print('txn_id', t.get('transaction_id'), 'amount', t.get('amount'), 'sender', sender.get('name'), sender.get('email'), 'created_at', t.get('created_at'), 'desc', t.get('description'))

# Determine paid participants by matching sender name with our note names.
# We'll use exact case-insensitive match OR prefix match.
note_names=list(shares.keys())

def name_matches(note_name, sender_name):
    if not note_name or not sender_name:
        return False
    a=note_name.strip().lower()
    b=sender_name.strip().lower()
    # exact
    if a==b:
        return True
    # prefix on shorter
    if b.startswith(a) or a.startswith(b):
        return True
    return False

paid=set()
paid_txn_details=[]
for t in received_txns:
    sender=t.get('sender',{})
    sender_name=sender.get('name','')
    sender_email=sender.get('email','')
    amt=float(t.get('amount',0.0))
    # match both amount and name
    for n,a in shares.items():
        if abs(amt-a)<1e-6 and name_matches(n, sender_name):
            paid.add(n)
            paid_txn_details.append((t.get('transaction_id'), n, amt, sender_name, sender_email, t.get('created_at'), t.get('description')))

print('paid participants inferred:', paid)
print('paid_txn_details count', len(paid_txn_details))
for det in paid_txn_details:
    print('detail', det)

# Determine who still needs requests
to_request = {n:amt for n,amt in shares.items() if n not in paid}
print('to_request:', to_request)
